name: Roti Jala Lace Pouring Cup
summary: Original Malaysian five-nozzle acuan cup and perforated net-crêpe display.
description: Original Malaysian roti jala display with a handled acuan cup, five open pouring bores, a separate open cradle and a real perforated net crêpe sample. Static heritage-inspired illustration, not a recipe or cookware specification.
author: Blender-3D-Gallery original procedural modeling
creation_method: Native procedural shell, constrained triangulated cup floor with five continuous bores, five real hollow annular nozzles, independent supporting cradle and sculpted net sample; Cycles studio still.
rights: Original project asset; redistribution terms for public downloads are not specified.
accuracy_notes: Static original conceptual exhibit, no actual food preparation, official utensil design, vendor, material safety or cookware specification. Blender +Z up/-Y outward, glTF +Y up/+Z outward.

attribution.credit: Original geometry, colors, lettering and stills.
Jabatan Warisan Negara heritage recognition of roti jala (food only).
JKKN Perlis Kuih Karas entry: passing mention of 3- or 5-nozzle roti jala molds (utensil family only).
